summary: Step 4 (Group / De-dup) sub-factor visual placement bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end via Playwright on the Expo web preview. The hierarchical IIFE renderer in /app/frontend/app/tools/pros-cons-wizard.tsx now correctly places child rows directly under their parent regardless of DB array position. PRIMARY: nesting Charlie under Alpha re-orders rows so Charlie appears immediately below Alpha (indented marginLeft:24, caption '↳ sub-factor of "Alpha"') and Bravo moves AFTER Charlie. SECONDARY: 'Promote out' restores Charlie to top-level (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie). TERTIARY: '+ Sub-factor' → text-input flow creates 'Charlie-child-new' as an indented child immediately below Bravo with caption '↳ sub-factor of "Bravo"'. Stat counters (ACTIVE/GROUPED) update correctly. Note: deprecated package warnings present (expo-av) — flagged below.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: Step 4 rendered factors in DB array order; when a child's parent_id was changed (move) it visually appeared adjacent to whichever sibling happened to be next in the array, not under the new parent. Fix: an IIFE renderer in Step 4 now builds a hierarchical render list — iterate top-level non-duplicates in order, immediately render each parent's children (with marginLeft:24 and parentName caption), then orphans, then duplicates. parentName is passed explicitly so the caption never says 'a main factor above' or similar ambiguous text. Verified via Playwright: row y-coordinates and computed marginLeft confirm child rows now sit directly below their true parent regardless of underlying array position.
